The Tower's Two Shadows

Sun at 60° or 30°, a 40 m clue: how tall is the tower?

REC
0:00 / 3:00

How it's made. Every frame is painted by JavaScript on one 1920×1080 canvas. The narration was synthesised offline and embedded in this file. The music and sound effects are generated live with Web Audio. Captions are the only text drawn on the canvas, and CC turns them off.

Recording. Record .webm restarts from 0:00 and captures the canvas at 60 fps together with the audio. It stops by itself at 3:00 and saves tower-two-shadows.webm. Keep this tab visible while it records.
